scope: Read-only audit of existing v5 task files, source files and independent NumPy FK; no GPU, IK, solver or planner execution.

model.base_transform: identity; +x forward, +z up; paper does not define world axes

semantic_findings.paper: VII-A1: 7DOF, 33 robot spheres, 20 obstacle spheres, box table
semantic_findings.actual: Same counts and primitive types; geometry itself constructed

semantic_findings.paper: Random right-side configuration to random left-side pose; no distribution given
semantic_findings.actual: Joint-uniform collision-free conditional FK target distribution; not Cartesian-uniform or Haar-uniform SO3

semantic_findings.paper: V-B: collision-free roadmap pose map warm-starts IK
semantic_findings.actual: Same procedure; translation+0.2*rotation public code metric, max10 attempts is constructed

semantic_findings.paper: Box table and obstacle cloud in front of robot; no world frame or dimensions
semantic_findings.actual: Identity base, tabletop z0, box1.4x1.6x0.1, center(.5,0,-.05)

semantic_findings.paper: Figure6 is an example, not a target orientation distribution
semantic_findings.actual: 6/10 target TCP z axes upward; cannot infer a requirement violation

semantic_findings.rule: Do not invent pairs or alter filters merely to match total

semantic_findings.paper: Simulation equations give symbolic bounds; unit bounds explicitly specified for hardware

proposed_sampling_protocol.primary_start: joint_uniform conditioned only on declared free endpoint and right TCP box
proposed_sampling_protocol.primary_target: independent joint_uniform witness conditioned only on declared free endpoint and left TCP box; save FK pose then freeze

optional_pose_space_diagnostic.orientation: Haar-uniform SO3 via uniform quaternion sampling

proposed_sampling_protocol.validation: Report all scheduled tasks, attrition and conditional-on-DRM results; geometry values frozen from independent evidence before outcomes
